title: Category Extension Contract v1
description: What a NEW jewelry category is expected to provide before it can move from 'planned' to 'current' — see docs/bible/18-ring-architecture/534-multi-category-readiness-contract.md. This schema describes the checklist itself, not a runtime object; nothing in the codebase currently satisfies it for any category other than ring.

mustNotRequireRewriting.description: The platform-level systems a new category must never need to modify — JDL infrastructure, Forge engine, Alchemist orchestration, Atlas core, Foundry, Vision core, Designer core, Conversation core, Professional Validation, Geometry Quality.
